content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to traverse all child classes of a traffic control (TC) class hierarchy when binding filters to classes. Specifically, when creating new classes (1:3 and 1:4) under a parent class (1:1), the code only searched for filters starting from the direct parent class instead of walking through all child classes of the parent qdisc. This oversight led to missing filters that required reverse binding, resulting in incorrect behavior in the traffic control system. The patch fixes this by implementing a mechanism to walk through all child classes of the qdisc, ensuring that all relevant filters are considered during the binding process.
